    - list:
      - listitem: Every match is a button that says its round, both contenders and who won – or that it's being judged
      - listitem: The match below the bracket is announced politely when it changes, and the bar says who's ahead
      - listitem: "Winning is never color alone: the winner keeps its full color and a check or its score, the other fades and its line is dashed"
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The match being judged shimmers; the one it prefers slides into the next round, the other fades back flat but stays
      - listitem: When the final is decided, the winner's way through the bracket draws itself in blue, round after round, and a cup appears in the final
      - listitem: The answers below ease to their new height when you open another match
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything simply appears
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every slot has a fixed height, so nothing moves while the judge works; the rounds share the width
      - listitem: When the rounds don't fit side by side it becomes a list per round, two contenders a row, and the answers stack
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""

      - listitem: Keep name to what makes the attempt different (model · prompt), and reason to one sentence
      - listitem: The blue of the winner's way is --ui-jbc-path; how far what you didn't pick fades is --ui-jbc-dim
